title: Farmslot self-validation recipe suite
description: Repo-local self-validation recipes for Command Center, Gateway, Mobile Companion, live replay, artifact viewing, and onboarding surfaces using the Generic Recipe Protocol v1 package shape.

recipes.proves: Validates the Command Center recipe tab, artifact viewer, replay controls, and ready/review workspace basics with reviewer-visible evidence.
Validates recipe-run RPCs, artifact index ingestion, run/family projection, and manifest contract without requiring visual replay.
Validates the v1 runner provenance envelope across summary, trace metadata, and typed artifact manifest metadata.
Validates the Mobile Companion run detail, decision/evidence review, recipe-run selector, artifact cards, and media viewer surfaces.
Replays a UI-class recipe on a warm slot, watches the stream stay visible, follows runner logs, and inspects newly created artifacts.
Validates protocol examples, self-validation fixtures, and onboarding commands with the shared v1 contract validator.
Proves the demo-gated Command Center monitoring banner via CDP-driven UI recipe on ff-* sandboxes.
